scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.setup:engine: cd engine && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: concurrently -n engine,server -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:engine" "npm run start -w server"
